title: hided WebSocket contract
description: Handshake, server frames, close reason codes, path refusal reason codes, and client dispatch events for hided.

serverFrame.description: snapshot/delta carry the core state; error answers a malformed client event; directory_list answers a `remote_file_list` for the `local` target and path_refused answers any event whose path failed its boundary - the $HOME line for `remote_file_list` and `create_workspace`, the checkout-root line for `file_open`, `reveal_path`, `file_save`, `file_create`, `dir_create`, `path_rename`, `path_move` and `path_trash` (see directoryList and pathRefused).

pathRefusalReason.description: outside_home: the real path is not under $HOME (a symlink target counts). home_root: $HOME itself cannot be a workspace. outside_checkout: the path is not under any registered checkout root, which is the reason an explorer event gets for a path under $HOME that no checkout covers. not_found: nothing exists there. not_a_directory: a file. invalid_path: empty, relative, contains `..` or NUL, or an item name that is empty, `.`, `..`, or holds a `/`.

directoryList.description: Payload of a directory_list frame: the visible subdirectories of root_path under $HOME. root_path is the real path that was listed (a request of `~` lists home and answers with its path). Files, hidden names, and symlinks that resolve outside home are absent; truncated is true past the listing cap.

pathRefused.description: Payload of a path_refused frame: the event kind that carried the path, the path as sent, and why hided did not forward it. A `file_create` or `dir_create` whose name failed the shape check, and a `path_rename` whose new name did, carry that name as the path.
